create_readout_block: create a ReadoutBlock instance with global, GNN, and regularization config objects
run_readout_block_forward: run the ReadoutBlock forward pass with graph data, node features, and edge features
build_global_readout: build a global readout using feedforward and normalization layers from node features via scatter reduce
build_node_readout: build a node readout by applying residual feedforward and normalization to node features
build_edge_readout: build an edge readout by applying residual feedforward and normalization to edge features for force regression
